none: PAS CAM-1BE26D: Roman Coin : copper-alloy radiate or barbarous radiate commemorating Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy barbarous radiate of a Divus Claudius II issue, commemorating Claudius II (AD 268-70), dating to c. AD 270-85 (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads CONS[ECRATIO]. Reverse shows an Eagle standing left, head right. Obverse legend is illegible [DIVO CLAVDIO]. Obverse shows an unclear radiate head right. Cunetio p. 160, no. 2877. Die axis is 12 o'clock.
